paragraphs.text: Let a man so account of us, as of ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
paragraphs.original: Οὕτως ἡμᾶς λογιζέσθω ἄνθρωπος ὡς ὑπηρέτας Χριστοῦ καὶ οἰκονόμους μυστηρίων θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Houtōs hēmas logizesthō anthrōpos hōs hypēretas Christou kai oikonomous mystēriōn theou.

paragraphs.text: Here, moreover, it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
paragraphs.original: ὧδε λοιπὸν ζητεῖται ἐν τοῖς οἰκονόμοις ἵνα πιστός τις εὑρεθῇ.
paragraphs.translit: hōde loipon zēteitai en tois oikonomois hina pistos tis heurethē.

paragraphs.text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man`s judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
paragraphs.original: ἐμοὶ δὲ εἰς ἐλάχιστόν ἐστιν, ἵνα ὑφʼ ὑμῶν ἀνακριθῶ ἢ ὑπὸ ἀνθρωπίνης ἡμέρας· ἀλλʼ οὐδὲ ἐμαυτὸν ἀνακρίνω·
paragraphs.translit: emoi de eis elachiston estin, hina hyphʼ hymōn anakrithō ē hypo anthrōpinēs hēmeras· allʼ oude emauton anakrinō·

paragraphs.text: For I know nothing against myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ σύνοιδα, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐν τούτῳ δεδικαίωμαι, ὁ δὲ ἀνακρίνων με κύριός ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: ouden gar emautō synoida, allʼ ouk en toutō dedikaiōmai, ho de anakrinōn me kyrios estin.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and make manifest the counsels of the hearts; and then shall each man have his praise from God.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε μὴ πρὸ καιροῦ τι κρίνετε, ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος, ὃς καὶ φωτίσει τὰ κρυπτὰ τοῦ σκότους καὶ φανερώσει τὰς βουλὰς τῶν καρδιῶν, καὶ τότε ὁ ἔπαινος γενήσεται ἑκάστῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hōste mē pro kairou ti krinete, heōs an elthē ho kyrios, hos kai phōtisei ta krypta tou skotous kai phanerōsei tas boulas tōn kardiōn, kai tote ho epainos genēsetai hekastō apo tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Now these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes; that in us ye might learn not [to go] beyond the things which are written; that no one of you be puffed up for the one against the other.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα δέ, ἀδελφοί, μετεσχημάτισα εἰς ἐμαυτὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν διʼ ὑμᾶς, ἵνα ἐν ἡμῖν μάθητε τό· Μὴ ὑπὲρ ἃ γέγραπται, ἵνα μὴ εἷς ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἑνὸς φυσιοῦσθε κατὰ τοῦ ἑτέρου.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta de, adelphoi, meteschēmatisa eis emauton kai Apollōn diʼ hymas, hina en hēmin mathēte to· Mē hyper ha gegraptai, hina mē heis hyper tou henos physiousthe kata tou heterou.

paragraphs.text: For who maketh thee to differ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? but if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory as if thou hadst not received it?
paragraphs.original: τίς γάρ σε διακρίνει; τί δὲ ἔχεις ὃ οὐκ ἔλαβες; εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔλαβες, τί καυχᾶσαι ὡς μὴ λαβών;
paragraphs.translit: tis gar se diakrinei; ti de echeis ho ouk elabes; ei de kai elabes, ti kauchasai hōs mē labōn;

paragraphs.text: Already are ye filled, already ye are become rich, ye have come to reign without us: yea and I would that ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
paragraphs.original: Ἤδη κεκορεσμένοι ἐστέ, ἤδη ἐπλουτήσατε, χωρὶς ἡμῶν ἐβασιλεύσατε· καὶ ὄφελόν γε ἐβασιλεύσατε, ἵνα καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμῖν συμβασιλεύσωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: Ēdē kekoresmenoi este, ēdē eploutēsate, chōris hēmōn ebasileusate· kai ophelon ge ebasileusate, hina kai hēmeis hymin symbasileusōmen.

paragraphs.text: For, I think, God hath set forth us the apostles last of all, as men doomed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, both to angels and men.
paragraphs.original: δοκῶ γάρ, ὁ θεὸς ἡμᾶς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ἐσχάτους ἀπέδειξεν ὡς ἐπιθανατίους, ὅτι θέατρον ἐγενήθημεν τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ ἀγγέλοις καὶ ἀνθρώποις.
paragraphs.translit: dokō gar, ho theos hēmas tous apostolous eschatous apedeixen hōs epithanatious, hoti theatron egenēthēmen tō kosmō kai angelois kai anthrōpois.

paragraphs.text: We are fools for Christ`s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye have glory, but we have dishonor.
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς μωροὶ διὰ Χριστόν, ὑμεῖς δὲ φρόνιμοι ἐν Χριστῷ· ἡμεῖς ἀσθενεῖς, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰσχυροί· ὑμεῖς ἔνδοξοι, ἡμεῖς δὲ ἄτιμοι.
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis mōroi dia Christon, hymeis de phronimoi en Christō· hēmeis astheneis, hymeis de ischyroi· hymeis endoxoi, hēmeis de atimoi.

paragraphs.text: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwelling-place;
paragraphs.original: ἄχρι τῆς ἄρτι ὥρας καὶ πεινῶμεν καὶ διψῶμεν καὶ γυμνιτεύομεν καὶ κολαφιζόμεθα καὶ ἀστατοῦμεν
paragraphs.translit: achri tēs arti hōras kai peinōmen kai dipsōmen kai gymniteuomen kai kolaphizometha kai astatoumen

paragraphs.text: and we toil, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we endure;
paragraphs.original: καὶ κοπιῶμεν ἐργαζόμενοι ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσίν· λοιδορούμενοι εὐλογοῦμεν, διωκόμενοι ἀνεχόμεθα,
paragraphs.translit: kai kopiōmen ergazomenoi tais idiais chersin· loidoroumenoi eulogoumen, diōkomenoi anechometha,

paragraphs.text: being defamed, we entreat: we are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things, even until now.
paragraphs.original: δυσφημούμενοι παρακαλοῦμεν· ὡς περικαθάρματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐγενήθημεν, πάντων περίψημα ἕως ἄρτι.
paragraphs.translit: dysphēmoumenoi parakaloumen· hōs perikatharmata tou kosmou egenēthēmen, pantōn peripsēma heōs arti.

paragraphs.text: I write not these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
paragraphs.original: Οὐκ ἐντρέπων ὑμᾶς γράφω ταῦτα, ἀλλʼ ὡς τέκνα μου ἀγαπητὰ νουθετῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Ouk entrepōn hymas graphō tauta, allʼ hōs tekna mou agapēta nouthetōn·

paragraphs.text: For though ye have ten thousand tutors in Christ, yet [have ye] not many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I begat you through the gospel.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν γὰρ μυρίους παιδαγωγοὺς ἔχητε ἐν Χριστῷ, ἀλλʼ οὐ πολλοὺς πατέρας, ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς ἐγέννησα.
paragraphs.translit: ean gar myrious paidagōgous echēte en Christō, allʼ ou pollous pateras, en gar Christō Iēsou dia tou euangeliou egō hymas egennēsa.

paragraphs.text: I beseech you therefore, be ye imitators of me.
paragraphs.original: παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς, μιμηταί μου γίνεσθε.
paragraphs.translit: parakalō oun hymas, mimētai mou ginesthe.

paragraphs.text: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who shall put you in remembrance of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every church.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἔπεμψα ὑμῖν Τιμόθεον, ὅς ἐστίν μου τέκνον ἀγαπητὸν καὶ πιστὸν ἐν κυρίῳ, ὃς ὑμᾶς ἀναμνήσει τὰς ὁδούς μου τὰς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, καθὼς πανταχοῦ ἐν πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ διδάσκω.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto epempsa hymin Timotheon, hos estin mou teknon agapēton kai piston en kyriō, hos hymas anamnēsei tas hodous mou tas en Christō Iēsou, kathōs pantachou en pasē ekklēsia didaskō.

paragraphs.text: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
paragraphs.original: ὡς μὴ ἐρχομένου δέ μου πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐφυσιώθησάν τινες·
paragraphs.translit: hōs mē erchomenou de mou pros hymas ephysiōthēsan tines·

paragraphs.text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will; and I will know, not the word of them that are puffed up, but the power.
paragraphs.original: ἐλεύσομαι δὲ ταχέως πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐὰν ὁ κύριος θελήσῃ, καὶ γνώσομαι οὐ τὸν λόγον τῶν πεφυσιωμένων ἀλλὰ τὴν δύναμιν,
paragraphs.translit: eleusomai de tacheōs pros hymas, ean ho kyrios thelēsē, kai gnōsomai ou ton logon tōn pephysiōmenōn alla tēn dynamin,

paragraphs.text: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἐν λόγῳ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλʼ ἐν δυνάμει.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar en logō hē basileia tou theou allʼ en dynamei.

paragraphs.text: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
paragraphs.original: τί θέλετε; ἐν ῥάβδῳ ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἢ ἐν ἀγάπῃ πνεύματί τε πραΰτητος;
paragraphs.translit: ti thelete; en rhabdō elthō pros hymas, ē en agapē pneumati te prautētos;
